name: PDS 415

paper.title: Planet-forming disks and their environment across regions and time from the full NIR census

notes: First-published SPHERE/IRDIS H-band polarimetric image (DESTINYS). A showcase detection: a very inclined disk with the upper rim nearly occulting the star and a back side almost as bright as the front side; an asymmetric arm in the northern part is interpreted as the edge-on view of a vertically extended spiral arm. Disk features: back side (Garufi et al. 2026, Table A.5/Fig. A.1).
